maddeler.e:
أنسلخ (form VII)
# أَنْسَلِخُ (ʔansaliḵu) /ʔan.sa.li.xu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# أَنْسَلِخَ (ʔansaliḵa) /ʔan.sa.li.xa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# أَنْسَلِخْ (ʔansaliḵ) /ʔan.sa.lix/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
